commands.text:
if [ -z "$TAG" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: tag input required (got empty value)"
  exit 1
fi
if ! echo "$TAG" | grep -Eq '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-.*)?$'; then
  echo "ERROR: tag '$TAG' does not match v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+(-.*)? semver pattern"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Validated tag: $TAG"
echo "RESOLVED_TAG=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high
pnpm run build:packages
pnpm run check
pnpm test
pnpm build

EXPECTED_VERSION="${RESOLVED_TAG#v}"
PKG_JSONS=(
  packages/storyboard-core/package.json
  packages/storyboard-routing/package.json
  packages/storyboard-canvas/package.json
  packages/rpg-storyboard-domain/package.json
  packages/marketing-storyboard-domain/package.json
  packages/cinematic-storyboard-domain/package.json
)
for PKG_JSON in "${PKG_JSONS[@]}"; do
  PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version "$PKG_JSON")
  PKG_NAME=$(jq -r .name "$PKG_JSON")
  if [ "$PKG_VERSION" != "$EXPECTED_VERSION" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: tag ${RESOLVED_TAG} does not match ${PKG_NAME} version ${PKG_VERSION} in ${PKG_JSON} (expected ${EXPECTED_VERSION})"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "OK: ${PKG_NAME}@${PKG_VERSION} matches ${RESOLVED_TAG}"
done
echo "All six publish targets match tag: ${RESOLVED_TAG}"

pnpm exec cyclonedx-npm \
  --ignore-npm-errors \
  --omit dev \
  --output-format JSON \
  --output-file storyboard-os.cdx.json
test -s storyboard-os.cdx.json
jq -e '.bomFormat == "CycloneDX"' storyboard-os.cdx.json >/dev/null
echo "Wrote $(wc -c < storyboard-os.cdx.json) bytes to storyboard-os.cdx.json"

set -euo pipefail
if [ "$HAS_RELEASE_EVENT" = "true" ]; then
  gh release upload "$RESOLVED_TAG" storyboard-os.cdx.json --clobber
  echo "Attached storyboard-os.cdx.json to $RESOLVED_TAG (release event)"
elif gh release view "$RESOLVED_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gh release upload "$RESOLVED_TAG" storyboard-os.cdx.json --clobber
  echo "Attached storyboard-os.cdx.json to existing release $RESOLVED_TAG"
else
  echo "No GitHub release for $RESOLVED_TAG (workflow_dispatch without a release) — skipping SBOM upload"
fi

PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/storyboard-core/package.json)
if pnpm view @storyboard-os/core@$PKG_VERSION version 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "@storyboard-os/core@$PKG_VERSION already published — skipping"
  echo "status=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  pnpm publish --filter @storyboard-os/core --no-git-checks --access public --provenance
  echo "status=published" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/storyboard-routing/package.json)
if pnpm view @storyboard-os/routing@$PKG_VERSION version 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "@storyboard-os/routing@$PKG_VERSION already published — skipping"
  echo "status=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  pnpm publish --filter @storyboard-os/routing --no-git-checks --access public --provenance
  echo "status=published" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/rpg-storyboard-domain/package.json)
if pnpm view @storyboard-os/rpg-domain@$PKG_VERSION version 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "@storyboard-os/rpg-domain@$PKG_VERSION already published — skipping"
  echo "status=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  pnpm publish --filter @storyboard-os/rpg-domain --no-git-checks --access public --provenance
  echo "status=published" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/storyboard-canvas/package.json)
if pnpm view @storyboard-os/canvas@$PKG_VERSION version 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "@storyboard-os/canvas@$PKG_VERSION already published — skipping"
  echo "status=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  pnpm publish --filter @storyboard-os/canvas --no-git-checks --access public --provenance
  echo "status=published" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/marketing-storyboard-domain/package.json)
if pnpm view @storyboard-os/marketing-domain@$PKG_VERSION version 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "@storyboard-os/marketing-domain@$PKG_VERSION already published — skipping"
  echo "status=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  pnpm publish --filter @storyboard-os/marketing-domain --no-git-checks --access public --provenance
  echo "status=published" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

PKG_VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/cinematic-storyboard-domain/package.json)
if pnpm view @storyboard-os/cinematic-domain@$PKG_VERSION version 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "@storyboard-os/cinematic-domain@$PKG_VERSION already published — skipping"
  echo "status=skipped" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  pnpm publish --filter @storyboard-os/cinematic-domain --no-git-checks --access public --provenance
  echo "status=published" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

echo "=== Publish summary ==="
echo "core:               ${{ steps.publish_core.outputs.status }}"
echo "routing:            ${{ steps.publish_routing.outputs.status }}"
echo "rpg-domain:         ${{ steps.publish_rpg_domain.outputs.status }}"
echo "canvas:             ${{ steps.publish_canvas.outputs.status }}"
echo "marketing-domain:   ${{ steps.publish_marketing_domain.outputs.status }}"
echo "cinematic-domain:   ${{ steps.publish_cinematic_domain.outputs.status }}"
echo ""
echo "=== Smoke-verify versions live on npm ==="
# name => directory mapping (npm package names don't match directory layout for domain packages)
declare -A PKG_DIRS=(
  ["core"]="packages/storyboard-core"
  ["routing"]="packages/storyboard-routing"
  ["canvas"]="packages/storyboard-canvas"
  ["rpg-domain"]="packages/rpg-storyboard-domain"
  ["marketing-domain"]="packages/marketing-storyboard-domain"
  ["cinematic-domain"]="packages/cinematic-storyboard-domain"
)
MISSING=0
MISMATCH=0
for PKG in core routing canvas rpg-domain marketing-domain cinematic-domain; do
  PKG_DIR="${PKG_DIRS[$PKG]}"
  if [ -f "${PKG_DIR}/package.json" ]; then
    EXPECTED=$(jq -r .version "${PKG_DIR}/package.json")
    ACTUAL=$(pnpm view "@storyboard-os/${PKG}@${EXPECTED}" version 2>/dev/null || echo "MISSING")
    echo "@storyboard-os/${PKG}: expected=${EXPECTED} live=${ACTUAL}"
    if [ "$ACTUAL" = "MISSING" ]; then
      MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
    elif [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
      MISMATCH=$((MISMATCH + 1))
    fi
  else
    echo "@storyboard-os/${PKG}: directory ${PKG_DIR} not found"
    MISSING=$((MISSING + 1))
  fi
done
if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ] || [ "$MISMATCH" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "ERROR: post-publish smoke failed (missing=${MISSING} mismatch=${MISMATCH})"
  exit 1
fi
echo "All expected @storyboard-os/* versions are live on npm."
